entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Yusuke, you've just thrown your[n]bright future down the drain.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I'll destroy every chance you've ever had[n]of becoming an artist!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Madarame!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: You'll forever rue the day you dared[n]defy me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Get... back here!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kitagawa-kun!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Why can't I move!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Listen, you're totally drained. You can't[n]do much, even if you wanted to!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What a disgrace I am!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, just listen to her.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You've known for quite some time,[n]haven't you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm no fool.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Strange people have been coming by[n]for years, and the plagiarism was an[n]everyday affair.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But... who would want to admit that[n]the man they owed their life to[n]was doing such terrible things?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why didn't you leave, Kitagawa-kun?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, he is the one who painted the[n]"Sayuri." On top of that, I owe him[n]a great debt...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You mean 'cause he raised you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I... never knew my father.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I was told my mother raised me by[n]herself, but she died in an accident[n]when I was three.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's when Sensei took me in. I heard[n]he helped my mother while she was still[n]alive.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Heard...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To be honest, I don't remember much[n]about my mother either.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I did everything I could for Sensei.[n]I thought of him as a father...[n]but he changed.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think he would treat the "Sayuri,"[n]the very foundation of his art,[n]like that!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...A lot's happened to you, huh?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: When you had mentioned plagiarism...[n]deep down I knew you were right.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's why I so vehemently denied you...[n]I was simply running from the truth.[n]I'm sorry.
No worries.
I understand.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Thank you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm grateful for the chance to face[n]what I have been denying all this time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm grateful for the chance to face[n]what I have been denying all this time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're way too serious, man.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's why you're always gettin' stuck[n]in your own head. Look at me! I just go[n]with the flow.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: For real.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What are you going to do now?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't know...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't help the fact that Madarame's[n]gone and changed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But... we can change his heart.[n]We'll make him pay for his crimes.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That reminds me, you mentioned[n]something about that "change of[n]heart" earlier...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Have you heard the rumors? The ones[n]about the Phantom Thieves that steal[n]hearts?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ......!? Don't tell me...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, crap!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll talk later! We need to scram!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: When did my clothes change?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You just noticed that now?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Save it for after! Let's go!
